## Root cause (proved read-only)

`rhema-prod-anthropic-admin-key` gained versions v2–v4 on 2026-10-29/30 (the owed H7 key-seeding
act) — `latest` = v4 since 10-30T04:30Z. The worker binds `versions/latest` at each instance boot;
the placeholder guard is intact (R7COPY.0 only reformatted it). Boots since 10-30T05:13Z bound the
non-placeholder v4 → the nightly fetch reaches Anthropic and is refused **403**
(authenticated-but-forbidden — a workspace key would 401 per STB.4; the credential is recognized but
not a usable Admin-API credential for this org: wrong-org admin key, wrong-surface key,
narrowed/revoked scope, or the org lacks Admin API access — the value itself was never read).
Failures began **2026-10-31T03:15Z** — 12 consecutive; the last 7 (11-05→11-11) survive the
completed_on+7 d cull and are the R6WATCH.1 datum's tail. Crucially the throw skipped
`assertBalances` — the nightly balances invariant had been dead since 10-30.

## Operator act (disposition — exact instructions, not faked)

The bound v4 credential is denied upstream. The operator must (1) classify v4
(`gcloud secrets versions access 4 --secret=rhema-prod-anthropic-admin-key` in an operator
shell — never in CI/records), (2) mint/seed a working `sk-ant-admin…` **in the same org the
prod workspace keys bill to** (`platform.claude.com/settings/admin-keys` → v5 via
`gcloud secrets versions add`), or — if the org lacks Admin API access — record
plan-unavailability; (3) the worker resolves `versions/latest` at each boot — no deploy needed
(a no-op `gcloud run services update` forces a fresh instance); (4) verify the next 03:15Z run
(or an operator `send`) logs `report=…`/`window=report $…` — the D-ECON.1-1/D-PRB.08-1
green-read criterion. Full steps in `runs/257_R6OPS.1.md`.
